title: Reading Drill — Changing where school buses stop — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Changing where school buses stop — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The school transport committee in Ravensmere received an old report about children crossing an entrance used by staff cars. The report compared conflicts between walkers and drivers, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the arrival observations rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered nine weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include special events. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed an alternate drop-off point as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
